posting.title: Senior Marketing Manager
posting.description:
About the role:
Lumen Consumer Goods is a Nordic FMCG brand looking for a Senior Marketing Manager to own our brand strategy across Denmark, Norway, and Sweden.

Responsibilities:
You will develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns across TV, print, and social media, manage our external creative agency relationship, and own the annual brand marketing budget.

Requirements:
7+ years of experience in brand or product marketing within FMCG or consumer goods is required. Strong storytelling and stakeholder-management skills, and experience briefing creative agencies, are required. Experience with marketing analytics tools is a plus.

Location and work mode:
Hybrid role based in our Copenhagen office, four days a week on-site.

What we offer:
Competitive salary, a company car allowance, and a collaborative brand team.
